svg.title: Ketover self-shrinking doubled planes: large-genus end schematic
svg.desc: Two generic graphical conical annuli indicate the upper and lower ends proved for sufficiently large genus. A dashed circle indicates a schematic neck region, not a collection of solved necks. The theorem gives entropy less than two for every positive genus and varifold convergence to a plane with multiplicity two. The figure is not an exact or numerical self-shrinker.

g.text: Large-genus end schematic • not a solved surface
Exactly two ends is proved only for sufficiently large genus.
Large-genus limit: a plane with multiplicity two (2P).
